appearance_facts.fact: The January bar is the leftmost of three blue bars; its top edge aligns exactly with the horizontal dashed line at the 150 level.
The February bar is the middle bar and is the tallest, extending well above the dashed line to the 300 level.
The March bar is the rightmost bar, extending above the dashed line to the 250 level.
A black dashed horizontal line labeled 'Average' runs across the chart at the 150 level; the January bar top meets this line, while February and March bars rise above it.

printed_facts.fact: Y-axis label is 'Inflow volume (Mm3)' with tick values 0, 50, 100, 150, 200, 250, 300, 350.
X-axis label is 'Month' with categories January, February, March.
